잠언 19:1.content: Better is the poor that walketh in his integrity, than he that is perverse in his lips, and is a fool.

잠언 19:2.content: Also, that the soul be without knowledge, it is not good; and he that hasteth with his feet sinneth.

잠언 19:3.content: The foolishness of man perverteth his way: and his heart fretteth against the Lord.

잠언 19:4.content: Wealth maketh many friends; but the poor is separated from his neighbour.

잠언 19:5.content: A false witness shall not be unpunished, and he that speaketh lies shall not escape.

잠언 19:6.content: Many will intreat the favour of the prince: and every man is a friend to him that giveth gifts.

잠언 19:7.content: All the brethren of the poor do hate him: how much more do his friends go far from him? he pursueth them with words, yet they are wanting to him.

잠언 19:8.content: He that getteth wisdom loveth his own soul: he that keepeth understanding shall find good.

잠언 19:9.content: A false witness shall not be unpunished, and he that speaketh lies shall perish.

잠언 19:10.content: Delight is not seemly for a fool; much less for a servant to have rule over princes.

잠언 19:11.content: The discretion of a man deferreth his anger; and it is his glory to pass over a transgression.

잠언 19:12.content: The king’s wrath is as the roaring of a lion; but his favour is as dew upon the grass.

잠언 19:13.content: A foolish son is the calamity of his father: and the contentions of a wife are a continual dropping.

잠언 19:14.content: House and riches are the inheritance of fathers: and a prudent wife is from the Lord.

잠언 19:15.content: Slothfulness casteth into a deep sleep; and an idle soul shall suffer hunger.

잠언 19:16.content: He that keepeth the commandment keepeth his own soul; but he that despiseth his ways shall die.

잠언 19:17.content: He that hath pity upon the poor lendeth unto the Lord; and that which he hath given will he pay him again.

잠언 19:18.content: Chasten thy son while there is hope, and let not thy soul spare for his crying.

잠언 19:19.content: A man of great wrath shall suffer punishment: for if thou deliver him, yet thou must do it again.

잠언 19:20.content: Hear counsel, and receive instruction, that thou mayest be wise in thy latter end.

잠언 19:21.content: There are many devices in a man’s heart; nevertheless the counsel of the Lord, that shall stand.

잠언 19:22.content: The desire of a man is his kindness: and a poor man is better than a liar.

잠언 19:23.content: The fear of the Lord tendeth to life: and he that hath it shall abide satisfied; he shall not be visited with evil.

잠언 19:24.content: A slothful man hideth his hand in his bosom, and will not so much as bring it to his mouth again.

잠언 19:25.content: Smite a scorner, and the simple will beware: and reprove one that hath understanding, and he will understand knowledge.

잠언 19:26.content: He that wasteth his father, and chaseth away his mother, is a son that causeth shame, and bringeth reproach.

잠언 19:27.content: Cease, my son, to hear the instruction that causeth to err from the words of knowledge.

잠언 19:28.content: An ungodly witness scorneth judgment: and the mouth of the wicked devoureth iniquity.

잠언 19:29.content: Judgments are prepared for scorners, and stripes for the back of fools.
